collections.title: The Heritage Christmas Edit
collections.headline: Velvet, tartan and candlelight, gathered the way a house remembers it
collections.intro: This is the Christmas a house inherits: deep green velvet, tartan wool, brass and candlelight, arranged around an evergreen mantel. Every piece is chosen to look collected over decades rather than bought in one season.
collections.art_note: Living room at dusk, low warm lamp and candle glow, cream velvet seating, deep green tartan wool throw across the arm, cedar garland along a dark wood mantel, brass hurricane holders, one brass bell at the door, evergreen and burgundy palette, natural light fading, linen and wool textures, real lived-in room, no people, no text.

collections.title: The Cozy Christmas Bedroom Edit
collections.headline: The softest room in the house, dressed for December
collections.intro: A Christmas bedroom should feel like the warmest corner of the house, which means brushed flannel, faux fur and low lamplight rather than tinsel. Layer these across a bed and a bedside table and the season arrives at bedtime too.
collections.art_note: Bedroom at night, unmade bed with cream faux fur throw over the foot, charcoal flannel bedding, olive knit throw, two cream cushions, warm pool of lamplight on a wooden nightstand, flameless candles in the window, tartan and cream palette, quiet and intimate, no people, no text.

collections.title: The Holiday Hosting Edit
collections.headline: Everything a host reaches for between November and January
collections.intro: Hosting is a table that is already set before anyone arrives: holly banded china, a pitcher big enough for the whole table, glassware that survives the dishwasher. These are the pieces that make a Christmas dinner feel effortless.
collections.art_note: Dining table set for a Christmas dinner, holly banded white plates, a large glass pitcher of eggnog, tree shaped wooden charcuterie platter, tall walnut candlesticks with burning tapers, clear votive glasses in a row, stemless wine glasses, brass and deep green accents, warm overhead glow, linen runner, no people, no text.

collections.title: The Luxe Christmas Tree Edit
collections.headline: A tree dressed properly, from the skirt to the last ornament
collections.intro: Start with the tree and the skirt, then add garland and ornaments until the light reads warm from the doorway. Nothing here needs a theme, only restraint and better materials.
collections.art_note: A slender cypress tree in a woven basket, cream cable knit tree skirt, champagne and pearl ornaments, two lit cedar garlands, sage velvet cone trees on a console, rusty metal deer, a full pine and cedar wreath on the door, warm fireplace light, cream and deep green palette, no people, no text.
